label: Finding-47
title: waf-nine-hours: The note's 'every vendor says ... patch anyway' is not carried for Fortinet
description: Cloudflare ('Customers should patch their PHP repos even with WAF protections'), Akamai ('The most effective defense continues to be the prompt application of vendor patches'), Fastly ('assume active mitigation will only serve as partial protection') and Imperva carry it. The Fortinet KB article gives signature and custom-rule steps and does not call them a stopgap or tell readers to patch.
